data.title: loanDepot, Inc. Addresses Notice of NYSE Trading Price Non-Compliance
data.description: In Irvine, California, loanDepot, Inc. has announced that they are addressing a notice of non-compliance with the NYSE trading price requirements. The company's stock, traded under the symbol $LDI, failed to meet the minimum trading price set by the NYSE. This news comes amid concerns about the company's stock performance, with shares currently trading below the required threshold. LoanDepot, Inc. is actively working to rectify this situation to ensure compliance with NYSE regulations.

data.title: Columbus Circle Capital Corp II Announces Elroy Air Was Awarded an Up to $46M Contract with U.S. Army
data.description: Today, Columbus Circle Capital Corp II (Nasdaq: CMII), which will become Inflection Point Acquisition Corp VII (Nasdaq: IPXG), announced that Elroy Air secured a $46,058,871 contract to develop an autonomous hybrid-electric VTOL uncrewed aircraft system in California. The project is expected to be completed by 2029. The initial funding of $5,135,354 from the FY 2026 research, development, test, and evaluation, defense-wide budget has been allocated. The Army Contracting Command in Maryland is overseeing the contracting activities for this project (W911QX-26-C-A016).

data.title: Jury Finds in Cytek’s Favor on Three of Four Asserted Claims; Company to Challenge Remaining Finding
data.description: Cytek Biosciences, based in Fremont, California, and listed on Nasdaq as CTKB, recently won a patent infringement case against Beckman Coulter, Inc. in the United States District Court for the District of Delaware. The jury ruled in favor of Cytek on three out of the four patent claims, citing noninfringement and invalidity on those three claims. However, one claim was found to be infringed under the doctrine of equivalents, leading to a verdict of $20 million in lost profits and $36 million in royalties. Cytek plans to challenge the infringement finding and the damages awarded through post-verdict motions.

data.title: Mesa Royalty Trust Announces There Will Be No Distribution for August 2026
data.description: Houston-based Mesa Royalty Trust (NYSE: MTR) disclosed that no distribution will be made for August 2026. This decision was influenced by the Trust's royalty properties facing higher costs, charges, and expenses compared to the revenue generated from the sale of oil, natural gas, and other hydrocarbons produced from these properties. The Trust, created to possess an overriding royalty interest in the net proceeds from said properties, had to forego distributions due to financial constraints in this specific period.

data.description: Insteel Industries Inc.
